experiments/exp188/design.md:1:# 实验 exp188: Occlusion-Asymmetric Self-Distillation (OA-SD)
experiments/exp188/design.md:5:- Teacher 看 clean image (pre-PLBOA) → clean structural tokens
experiments/exp188/design.md:6:- Student 看 occluded image (post-PLBOA) → degraded tokens
experiments/exp188/design.md:7:- Distillation: student tokens 逼近 teacher tokens（cosine distance）
experiments/exp188/design.md:8:- **使用 EMA teacher**：teacher 是 student 的 exponential moving average (decay=0.999)
experiments/exp188/design.md:9:- Teacher 用 eval mode 做 forward (no dropout/droppath)，每个 optimizer step 后 EMA 更新
experiments/exp188/design.md:10:- 与 PersonMAE 的区别：distill identity-level tokens 而非 reconstruct pixels
experiments/exp188/design.md:14:通过让 student (看到遮挡图像) 的 structural tokens 逼近 teacher (看到完整图像) 的 tokens，
experiments/exp188/design.md:22:  ├─ clean_img (pre-PLBOA) ─→ EMA Teacher forward (eval, no_grad) → clean tokens
experiments/exp188/design.md:23:  └─ occluded_img (post-PLBOA) ─→ Student forward (train) → degraded tokens
experiments/exp188/design.md:27:                               Distillation loss (cosine distance to EMA teacher)
experiments/exp188/design.md:30:                               EMA update: teacher = 0.999 * teacher + 0.001 * student
experiments/exp188/design.md:35:2. `datasets/pose_dataset.py`: OA-SD mode 保存 pre-PLBOA clean image
experiments/exp188/design.md:37:4. `processor/processor.py`: teacher forward (no_grad) + distillation loss

experiments/exp237/claude_review.md:19:**动机清晰**: 236 个实验的系统总结证明 detached feature 上的所有操作都无法改善最终结果。只有改变 backbone 本身行为的方法（PSG, OA-SD）有效。PPA 尝试用 learnable part-assignment head 取代 detached GCN sampling，让 part loss 梯度端到端流过 backbone。
experiments/exp237/claude_review.md:127:### C4. OA-SD 兼容性
experiments/exp237/claude_review.md:129:**Teacher 也会运行 PPA**: OA-SD teacher 在 `train()` mode (line 714) + `no_grad()` 下执行 forward。由于 `self.training=True`，PPA 的训练路径会被触发。Teacher 产生相同结构的输出: `[global_cls, pooled_cls, part1_cls, ..., part5_cls]`。
experiments/exp237/claude_review.md:132:- Distillation: `zip(student_feat, teacher_feat)` 逐元素匹配。Student 7 features vs Teacher 7 features — 结构匹配。正确。
experiments/exp237/claude_review.md:183:- 结合 Global ID + Global triplet + OA-SD distillation，backbone 同时接收 6-7 种 loss 的梯度。
experiments/exp237/claude_review.md:213:- OA-SD: teacher 结构匹配，distillation 安全

experiments/exp199/claude_review.md:15:- OA-SD (feature distillation) 作用于 individual features (global 或 token)，约束它们向 teacher 的方向收敛 — 这与 SupCon 在同一空间上施加相反方向的力
experiments/exp199/claude_review.md:18:**关键区别**：OA-SD 的梯度形如 ∂L/∂f_i ∝ (f_i - f_teacher_i)，直接推动 f_i 向特定方向移动。OA-RD 的梯度形如 ∂L/∂f_i ∝ Σ_j w_j * (f_j - <f_i,f_j>*f_i)，它通过 pairwise cosine 传播，更关心保持相对结构。而且 OA-RD 仅在 global feature 上操作，SupCon 在 token features 上操作，特征空间完全不重叠。
experiments/exp199/claude_review.md:24:- Relational Knowledge Distillation (RKD) 是成熟方法，但在 occluded ReID 的 EMA self-distillation 框架下应用无先例
experiments/exp199/claude_review.md:25:- 与 OA-SD 失败 (exp188/196) 形成对照 → 如果 OA-RD 成功，证据链完整
experiments/exp199/claude_review.md:45:- Teacher detach：`t_global.detach()`。**正确，梯度不回流到 teacher。**
experiments/exp199/claude_review.md:46:- Temperature 除法应用于 student 和 teacher 两侧。**正确（对称温度）。**
experiments/exp199/claude_review.md:56:- `F.kl_div` 签名：`F.kl_div(input=log_prob, target=prob)`。student 是 log_softmax，teacher 是 softmax。**正确。**

experiments/exp199/claude_review.md:148:- **评估**：实际上对角线在 teacher 和 student 侧都同样为 1.0/temp，所以 KL 中对角线贡献趋近 0（相同的 softmax 输出）。真正的学习信号来自 off-diagonal。这是正确的行为。**无需修改。**

experiments/exp208/claude_review.md:9:## Critical: GLOBAL_LOSS_SCALE 在 GCN+PAA 路线下无效（NO-OP）
experiments/exp208/claude_review.md:25:但 GCN+PAA 模型返回 **列表** score 和 feat（`pose_backbone_model.py` L517: `return [cls_score] + gcn_cls_scores, [global_feat] + gcn_feats, ...`），所以 loss 函数走 `isinstance(score, list)` 路径（L128-211），该路径使用 `POSE_PART_WEIGHT` 的 `w_g/w_p` 机制，**完全不读取 GLOBAL_LOSS_SCALE**。
experiments/exp208/claude_review.md:27:换言之，设 `GLOBAL_LOSS_SCALE=0.5` 在 GCN+PAA 路线下会被 **静默忽略**，exp208 训练结果将与 exp206 完全一致（除随机种子差异）。
experiments/exp208/claude_review.md:48:**审查不通过。** exp208 的 `GLOBAL_LOSS_SCALE=0.5` 在 GCN+PAA 路线下是一个 NO-OP——设置会被静默忽略，训练行为与 exp206 完全相同。必须重新审视实验目标后决定是否修改 loss 代码或取消实验。

experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:1:# exp198 STM + OA-SD + CE — Claude Review
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:5:本实验为纯配置组合实验：将 exp197 的 STM 功能叠加到 exp191 的 OA-SD + CE 配置上。
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:6:无新增/修改代码。审查重点是两个已审查通过的功能（STM、OA-SD）在组合使用时的交互安全性。
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:10:- processor/processor.py — 训练循环中 STM 和 OA-SD 的执行流
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:16:在 OA-SD 模式下（`len(img)==2`），训练循环的执行顺序如下：
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:18:1. **数据拆分**（行 448-452）：`img[0]` 为 student（post-PLBOA），`img[1]` 为 teacher（clean）
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:23:6. **OA-SD**（行 680-728）：EMA teacher forward `img_teacher`，计算蒸馏 loss，加入 `loss`
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:25:8. **EMA update**（行 750-755）：更新 teacher 参数
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:29:## b. STM 与 OA-SD 交互安全性
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:33:- STM 操作的是 student forward 产出的 `score`/`feat`（行 538），通过 slice + cat 创建混合 batch
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:34:- OA-SD 操作的也是同一份 `feat`（行 704），但只读取不修改（`F.normalize` 创建新 tensor）
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:35:- Teacher forward（行 687）使用 `img_teacher`（clean 图像），完全独立于 student
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:42:- 主 loss（行 533）→ STM loss 累加（行 592）→ OA-SD loss 累加（行 726）
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:46:- OA-SD 写入 keys: `oa_sd`
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:54:- OA-SD loss 的梯度：`oa_sd_loss` → `F.normalize(feat[i])` → `feat[i]` → 模型参数
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:55:- Teacher 侧 `tf.detach()` 阻断梯度（行 707/714/723），只有 student 侧有梯度
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:60:### b4. EMA Teacher 不受 STM 影响
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:62:- EMA update（行 750-755）在 `optimizer.step()` 之后执行
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:63:- 更新基于 student 模型参数（`base_model.parameters()`），不基于 loss 的具体组成
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:64:- STM 通过影响 loss → 影响梯度 → 影响 optimizer step → 间接影响 EMA update
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:65:- 这是预期行为：STM 改善 student 特征 → EMA teacher 也逐步改善
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:67:**结论：EMA 更新逻辑不受 STM 直接干扰。**
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:73:- OA-SD 模式下：student forward + teacher forward（no_grad）
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:75:- 远程 16GB GPU：exp191 (OA-SD + CE) 已验证可运行，STM 额外开销 < 150MB
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:83:- exp198 通过命令行启用 `POSE_STM True`，与 OA-SD 配置项（`POSE_OA_SD True`）无冲突
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:89:无新问题。STM 和 OA-SD 是完全独立的 loss 组件，操作不同阶段，无数据/梯度/内存冲突。
experiments/exp198/claude_review.md:95:**审查通过。** STM（exp197 已审查通过）和 OA-SD（多次审查通过）在 processor 中的执行路径完全独立：STM 在主 loss 后立即执行（行 535-595），OA-SD 在 parallel_aug 之后执行（行 680-728），两者均只读取原始 `score`/`feat`，各自计算独立的 loss 分量并累加。无数据修改冲突、无 key 冲突、无梯度干扰。可以启动训练。

experiments/exp196/claude_review.md:109:**关于"小调参"质疑**: 本实验是纯配置组合，无新代码。但它组合的三个组件各自已单独验证有效，且 exp188 证明了 naive 全 token OA-SD + SupCon 失败，exp195 证明了 global-only 版本成功。因此本实验是对"职责分离"假说在完整 3-view 环境下的最终验证，具有论文消融表价值。可以接受。

experiments/decisions.md:693:- 🔴 红队（方案 A: PCRA）核心论点: PCRA 是唯一操作在未被探索维度（loss 距离度量）上的方案。26 个实验证明所有 forward path 改动都干扰 PSG，但 PCRA 不修改 forward path 也不添加 aux loss——它只改变 hard mining 中的距离计算。这是论文方法的"第三层"贡献（特征层 PSG + 架构层 PDS + 度量层 PCRA）。实现仅~20 行代码，0 新参数。风险极低：最差退化为 PSG baseline。Occluded-Duke 中 pose 相似的 negative 才是真正的 hard case（两个只露上半身的不同人），标准 triplet loss 对此毫无感知。PVR 的弱点在于 exp020 (PRA) 已证明辅助 loss 方向中性/负面(-0.5%)，且需要 part feature 提取（与 exp008 的失败模式重叠）。SPD 调参无论文价值。信心: 8/10
experiments/decisions.md:712:  A. 改进 PDS+StopGrad（改善 Part 分支收敛，如 Part LR boost、Part warmup、feature distillation）

experiments/decisions.md:1140:**关键数据发现**: Occluded-Duke 训练集 person-0 的可见关键点比例均值 **95.8%**，中位数 **100%**。95.6% 的训练图可见率 > 80%。训练数据几乎没有遮挡。

experiments/decisions.md:3096:**上下文**: 5 个研究 agent 并行调研后，发现 Relational Knowledge Distillation (RKD, CVPR 2019) 可能解决 OA-SD vs SupCon 互斥问题。OA-SD 在 token 级别 match 个体特征 → 与 SupCon 冲突。RKD match pairwise similarity structure → 不碰个体特征 → 理论上与 SupCon 兼容。
experiments/decisions.md:3099:  A. OA-RD (Relational Distillation): Teacher 和 student 的 batch-level pairwise similarity 一致

experiments/decisions.md:3115:**核心发现**: 任何形式的 EMA self-distillation (OA-SD/OA-RD) 都与 SupCon 不兼容。

experiments/decisions.md:4428:### [2026-04-25] 决策 #Base OD LR sweep → LR8 最优，LR2 下界，PLBOA OD net positive
experiments/decisions.md:4430:**上下文**：overnight Base OD LR sweep（exp296/297/298）+ PLBOA 消融（exp299）。
experiments/decisions.md:4432:**PLBOA 消融**：exp299(OFF) 72.7/80.5 vs exp296(ON) 74.9/83.8 → OD 上 **PLBOA net +2.2 mAP**；配 Tiny exp307(+2.7) 2-backbone 一致
experiments/decisions.md:4433:**选择**：LR8 sweet spot；PLBOA OD-train 启用、Market-train 关闭（dataset-specific）。
experiments/decisions.md:4434:**理由**：LR4≈LR8（非显著 underfit），LR2 严重 underfit -5.3。PLBOA 在 Occ-Duke +2.2-2.7 mAP，但 Market→Occ-ReID 跨域 -25.4 mAP（exp293 vs exp269）。
experiments/decisions.md:4435:**执行结果**：Base OD 主表保持 exp263d 75.2/84.8；exp296-298 作 LR ablation，exp299/exp307 作 PLBOA dataset-specific evidence。

experiments/decisions.md:4657:**上下文**: 20-codex 调研后用户选 PGPD(pose选完整teacher蒸馏prompt simplex暗知识)+ PC-MSC(pose mask可见部位重建冻结CLIP部位语义)两个训练端弱赌注。全协议(design→kill-switch→Claude+Codex双审→训练+random控制)走完。
experiments/decisions.md:4660:- PGPD: exp355(pose)58.6 / exp355r(random)59.0 / exp341 59.8 → **-1.2**, pose选teacher≈random(噪声内)无价值。
experiments/decisions.md:4664:**理由**: CLIP=全局语义工具(特征各向异性、部位ID弱), pose=空间结构工具; 二者能力不重叠处恰好无法在对方层面发挥。两训练端机制同模式: 机制本身负、pose成分(teacher/mask选择)无关。

experiments/exp139/claude_review_v2.md:20:1. **训练与测试的 `pair_change` 来源不同但语义一致** — 训练中 context 的 `pair_change` 为 `|kp_dist - base_dist|`（line 404），测试中也是 `|kp_dist - base_dist|`（`metrics.py:306`）。两者语义完全一致。但训练中还有另一个 `pair_change = |teacher_dist - base_dist|` 用于 pair weighting（line 394），名称重叠容易混淆。代码逻辑无误，但后续维护时需注意这两个同名变量的区别。**不阻塞启动。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4304:experiments/results.md:1654:> post-PRCV「搬范式」#2 路线。frozen DINOv2-base（lab-3090-d, RTX 3090），全量 Occluded-Duke（2210 query × 17661 gallery，无后处理、无训练）。脚本 `scripts/exp324_dino.py`。输入 224W×448H → patch grid 32×16。keypoints 缩放到 grid → 每部位 3×3 窗均值池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility，跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 per-part cosine（part-MaxSim）。重遮挡子集 = query visibility_binary.sum()≤8（989/2210）。**training-free，不计入主表增益。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4314:experiments/results.md:1701:> exp324d = LoRA 解冻 DINOv2-base/large + 可微 pose-part-MaxSim（破 exp324b 冻结天花板）。exp324i = 在其上加跨网络跨协方差解相关损失（逼 DINO-global 与 frozen-Swin-global 线性无关）。Occluded-Duke，BS=64，rank16 除非标注。**单分支 part-MaxSim = 纯模型；fusion(⊕Swin) = test-time 后处理(NFC 级)，不计训练端增益。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4348:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4366:- **另一面**: `tau=0.05` 把 cos∈[-1,1] 拉到 logits∈[-20,20]。当 ≥2 列有效且原型(EMA of 1-4 样本，L103)还很 noisy 时，若 own 不是 argmax，CE 梯度极尖 → 训练初期对 encoder 注入大梯度。整体 OVP 行为**双峰**(退化≈0 / 尖峰)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4383:- **事实**: `update` 喂的是 L261 forward 出的**同一个 `bn`**(step 前激活，仅 detach)，并未在 `optimizer.step()` 后重新前向。所以"放到 step 之后"在数值上**什么都没买到**——原型由 iter t 的 step-前特征构建，被 t+1 的 loss 消费（一步陈旧 teacher，符合标准 memory-bank 行为，**无反馈环 bug**）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4426:`update` L104 `gmean=fv[lv==pid].mean(0)` 若同 pid K=4 样本方向高度发散，pre-normalize 均值可能 small-norm，eps=1e-12 下放大噪声。但 EMA(L109，momentum 0.2 混两个单位向量)最小范数≈0.6，**真 div-by-zero 不可达**。trained 特征下概率极低，仅记录。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4429:本文件**单 `device='cuda'`、无 DataParallel/DDP**，buffer 正确。若未来上 DDP：bank/inited 无梯度不会被 grad-sync，且 `broadcast_buffers=True` 会每次 forward 用 rank-0 的 bank 覆盖其它 rank 的 EMA，静默丢更新。当前不触发，仅作未来告警。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4461:- **模块1 OVP-Mem(Opposite-View Prototype Memory)**: 每 train pid 维护 aerial / ground 两个 EMA 原型。样本除 CE+triplet 外, aerial image 拉近同 pid 的 **ground** 原型(InfoNCE: sim(z, P[y, opp_view])/τ 分类到 y)。≠死掉的 CV-triplet(那是 batch 内跨视角正对稀缺假设, 已证 88% batch 有; 这里是**全局原型级跨视角监督, 覆盖 hard tail**)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4471:baseline 32.48 → +OVP-Mem → +Local-MaxSim → +both; K(token 数) / β / τ 敏感性; EMA momentum。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4499:- **OVP-Mem 的硬伤是 novelty 撞车**(claude/codex 双审都标 High): per-view EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE ≈ **CMPC(CVPR22)/MBCE(AAAI23)/PDPA(2025 同 CARGO)** 近乎逐字同构, 当 headline 过不了 novelty review。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4501:- **OVLI 保留方向、换掉撞车的机制**: 把 per-pid prototype contrast 改成 **token-set late-interaction(ColBERT/MaxSim 风格)的 sample-to-sample 跨视角检索 loss**——无 prototype/memory/EMA, 直接局部 token 集合**部分匹配**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4515:   - 多正样本: **logsumexp supervised-contrastive**(`L_i = -logsumexp(score(i,pos)/τ) + logsumexp(score(i,cand)/τ)`, τ=0.05), 对"有 ≥1 opp 正 且 ≥1 opp 负"的 anchor 求均值。**无 memory/EMA/prototype。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4530:- vs OVP/CMPC/MBCE/PDPA: **无 prototype/memory/EMA**, sample-to-sample late-interaction, 这正是绕开 OVP 撞车的点。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4850:**为什么转 OVLI**: OVP ep30 到 39.18(+大, 证方向有 BIG headroom), 但 OVP novelty 撞 CMPC/MBCE/PDPA。OVLI 保方向换机制——token-set late-interaction(MaxSim)的 sample-to-sample 跨视角检索 loss, 无 prototype/memory/EMA。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:5075:- CMPC is a prototype contrast family; this is the OVP collision, not an OVLI collision because OVLI has no memory/prototype/EMA. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.14057?utm_source=openai))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:5110:- CMPC is a prototype contrast family; this is the OVP collision, not an OVLI collision because OVLI has no memory/prototype/EMA. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.14057?utm_source=openai))
experiments/exp197/claude_review_v2.md:85:### e7. 与 OA-SD 的交互
experiments/exp197/claude_review_v2.md:87:OA-SD 在 parallel_aug 之后，操作 teacher forward 的输出，与 STM 完全独立。无冲突。
experiments/exp197/claude_review_v2.md:128:**审查通过。** v1 中发现的全部 3 个需修复问题（1 Critical + 2 Medium）均已正确修复。固定数量生成策略保证了 triplet loss 的等正样本数假设，梯度流正确，与 SupCon/OA-SD/parallel_aug 等现有功能无冲突。可以启动训练。

experiments/exp222/monitor.md:86:**Small 的 GCN+PAA+OA-SD+MaxSim 72.4% 仍是最佳。**
experiments/exp136/claude_review.md:35:**风险等级**：可接受——这是 `delta_top` 的 intended behavior，且 `pair_weight` 选择的是 teacher-change 最大的正对（信噪比理论上最高的那个）。但需要在训练日志中关注 `lpcs_psr` 是否出现异常波动。
experiments/exp136/claude_review.md:75:| **共享接线 bug 是否已真正修复** | ✅ 已修复 | `processor.py:602` 条件现为 `kp_triplet_enabled or csgt_enabled or csrd_enabled or ltcs_enabled or lpcs_enabled or paml_enabled or kdl_enabled or lku_enabled or pke_enabled`，`lpcs_enabled` 已包含在内。当 `POSE_LPCS=True` 时，`kp_aux_data` 会被正确构建，后续 `lpcs_teacher_feats` 会被注入（L639-646），`_compute_lpcs_loss` 会被调用（L682-705）。 |
experiments/exp136/claude_review.md:76:| **单变量性** | ✅ 通过 | `diff` 确认 exp136 config 相对 exp135 config 仅新增 `POSE_LPCS_PAIR_MODE: 'delta_top'` 和 `POSE_LPCS_PAIR_TOP_RATIO: 0.25`，以及 `OUTPUT_DIR` 不同。所有其他参数（scorer/descriptor/teacher bank/cvk_residual/优化器/训练设置）完全一致。 |
experiments/exp136/claude_review.md:78:| **delta_top 是否真的能形成 sparse routing** | ✅ 能 | `_select_top`（L344-351）使用 `torch.topk` 选取 `pair_weight` 前 25% 的 pair。`pair_weight`（L380-381）由 `\|teacher_dist - base_dist\|` 归一化后得到，代表 teacher bank 对该 pair 的改变幅度。Top-25% 选择后，仅高 teacher-change pair 参与 ranking loss。梯度仅流经 `lpcs_head(desc)` 产出的 `delta`，`pos_sel/neg_sel` 是 detach bool mask，不阻断梯度链。 |

experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:3:> **来源**：post-PRCV「搬范式 / 重定义问题」路线。前置探针 `scripts/vcnorm_probe.py`（commit e3a709b）已证前提成立：在 Market 全可见训练的 exp260b 模型上，Occluded-ReID 被遮挡部位的 per-part GCN token 归一化统计（per-channel mean/var）漂到与可见 token 明显不同、近完美线性可分的区（pre-GCN KL≈288 / LDA-AUC≈0.97，post-GCN 仍 KL 数十 / AUC≈0.8），且 3 个对照证明不是采样伪影。**遮挡 = 未对齐的 domain factor**。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:5:> **baseline**：exp260b（Swin-Base + 2-stage PSG + LGPA-D + GCN512 + OA-SD + PLBOA），Market 训练 → Occluded-ReID 跨域 = **88.0 mAP（MaxSim + flip）**。目标 **> 88.0**。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:9:exp260b 已有 OA-SD（occluded student ↔ clean EMA teacher 双前向）+ PLBOA（下肢遮挡增广），但其蒸馏只作用在 **pooled global 特征**（cosine）。BT-PKD 进一步蒸馏 per-keypoint 特征**方向**（cosine），仍是「让被遮挡 token 的特征向 clean token 看齐」。两者都没有触碰探针指认的真正病灶：**被遮挡 per-part token 的归一化统计（一阶/二阶矩）整体漂移到一个可分离的子空间**——这是一条「有/无遮挡」的 domain 轴，叠加在身份信号上。OA-SD/BT-PKD 把个体特征拉近，但没有显式消掉这条 domain 轴；探针显示这条轴在跨域时大量残留（pre-GCN AUC 0.97），GCN 只部分修复。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:15:在 exp260b 的 dual-forward（occluded student / clean teacher）之上，对 GCN 的 17 个 per-keypoint token 加一个 **VisibilityConditionedNorm（VCN）模块** + **可见性条件统计对齐 loss（VCA）**：训练时把 student 路被遮挡 token 的 per-keypoint per-channel 归一化统计对齐到 teacher（clean）路同 keypoint 的统计，能消掉「遮挡 domain 轴」、让 visible-part 表示对有/无遮挡鲁棒，从而把 Market→Occluded-ReID 跨域 mAP 抬过 88.0。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:27:2. **对齐 loss** `loss/vcnorm_loss.py` → `def vcnorm_align_loss(student_kp, teacher_kp, student_scores, teacher_scores, vis_thr, ...)`：
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:28:   - **机制（核心新意）**：不是 per-instance 拉特征（那是 OA-SD/BT-PKD），而是**对齐 per-keypoint 的"可见性条件归一化统计"**。对每个 keypoint k，在 batch 内取 student 路该 keypoint 的 token 群，估计其 per-channel mean/var（一阶/二阶矩），与 teacher 路同 keypoint 的 mean/var 做对齐（Gaussian/统计距离，**与探针同一把尺子**：对角高斯一阶/二阶矩匹配）。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:29:   - **★ student 统计取自"被遮挡子集"（codex High-1 修复，核心机制点）**：PLBOA 把被遮挡 keypoint 的 score 置 0，但 **GCN token 本身不是 0-mask**——keypoint 坐标保留，标准 bilinear 采样仍在被遮挡像素位置采到一个退化但真实的"遮挡特征"（backbone 对 occluder 像素的响应），这正是探针指认、要被拉向 clean 的 domain-shifted token。陷阱：若像旧实现那样用 student score 给 student 矩加权，被遮挡 token（score≈0）几乎不进 batch 统计、拿不到对齐梯度，VCA 退化成"对齐本来就可见的 token"=空转、与目标相反。**修复**：student 矩只在 **被遮挡且 teacher 可见的 keypoint 子集（`s_sc < vis_thr` 且 `t_sc >= vis_thr`）** 上估计，权重用 **teacher score**（student score≈0 不能当权重）。这样被遮挡 student token 真正进入统计并被拉向 clean teacher。`valid_k` 同时要求 teacher 侧和 student-occluded 侧都有足够权重（双 min-count gate，codex Medium-b）。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:31:   - **可见性条件化**：teacher（clean）路 keypoint 几乎全可见，其统计 = 「无遮挡」目标分布；student 路含被 PLBOA 遮挡的 keypoint，把它们的统计拉向 teacher → 消 domain 轴。对低于 `vis_thr` 的 teacher keypoint 跳过（teacher 自己都看不见就没有可靠目标）。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:32:   - **detach teacher**：teacher 矩 `.detach()`，单向对齐。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:41:   _C.MODEL.POSE_VCNORM_VIS_THR = 0.3        # 可见性阈值：teacher 低于则跳过；student 低于则视为"被遮挡"进对齐子集
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:52:5. **processor 接线** `processor/processor.py`：在 OA-SD 段（已算好 `teacher_kp_data`）后追加 VCA loss：
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:54:   if vcnorm_enabled and epoch > vcnorm_warmup and kp_data is not None and teacher_kp_data is not None:
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:56:       t_kp = teacher_kp_data.get('gcn_kp_feats'); t_sc = teacher_kp_data.get('gcn_kp_weights')
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:61:   - **复用现成 dual-forward**：exp260b 已是 `parallel_oa_sd`（3 occluded student + 1 clean teacher），teacher 前向已在 OA-SD 段算出 `teacher_kp_data`，**VCA 不新增前向、不增显存峰值的额外 backbone pass**。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:65:1. dataloader 出 4 视图：`img[0..2]`=PLBOA 遮挡 student，`img[3]`=clean teacher；`pose_dict` 含 student（被遮挡 keypoint score=0）与 `teacher_pose`（全可见）。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:66:2. student 前向：backbone(PSG) → featmap → GCN 采 17 token → **VCN（可见性条件仿射，zero-init 恒等起步）** → `kp_data['gcn_kp_feats'] (B,17,C)`, `gcn_kp_weights (B,17)`。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:67:3. EMA teacher 前向（已存在，no_grad）：clean 图 + `teacher_pose` → `teacher_kp_data['gcn_kp_feats']`（全可见目标统计）。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:68:4. VCA loss：per-keypoint 在 batch 内估 student/teacher 的 per-channel mean/var → 对齐距离（teacher detach）→ `vcnorm_weight * vcn_loss` 加进总 loss。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:69:5. 反传**不更新 backbone**：GCN 分支输入是 `featmaps[-1].detach()`（`pose_backbone_model.py:608`），所以 VCA / GCN 分支只更新 **GCN + VCN + skeleton head**，backbone 经此路径拿不到梯度（codex Medium-c）。teacher 不更新（EMA 跟随 student）。注意 PSG / 主 ID·triplet 仍走非 detach 路更新 backbone，但那不是 VCA 的贡献。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:70:6. 测试：student-only 前向，GCN token 过同一个 VCN（train/test 对称），equal_concat + MaxSim + flip 评测。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:74:- `WEIGHT=0.5`：与 PLBOA 体系内 part 分支、FSDC、PACI 等辅助 loss 同量级，避免压过 ID/triplet 主 loss。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:82:- **成立**：Occluded-ReID（Market→跨域）mAP/R1 > 88.0/baseline；日志里 VCA 的「对齐前矩距离 > 对齐后矩距离」单调改善，gamma/beta 不塌缩（std>0）；Market 同分布性能不掉（对齐不抹身份的证据）。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:91:  - 实验组：`configs/market/pose_vcnorm_base.yml`（`POSE_VCNORM=True`，PLBOA=True）。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:92:  - 对照组：`configs/market/pose_vcnorm_base_control.yml`——**与实验组逐行相同，唯一差异 `POSE_VCNORM=False`**（PLBOA 仍 True）。单变量 = VC-Norm 开/关。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:93:  - VC-Norm 净增益**只能 vs 这条对照**，**不能 vs 原 exp260b 88.0**（后者 PLBOA=False，是另一条 baseline）。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:94:- **PLBOA 说明（重要）**：exp260b 原 config `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False`，此时 OA-SD 的 teacher≈student（代码已 warning「near-identical images」），OA-SD 近退化。VC-Norm 要 occluded-vs-clean 的对比信号**必须开 PLBOA**，故本实验与对照都设 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`。因此严格单变量对照是「同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关」，**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（后者 PLBOA 关）。88.0 仅作量级参照；若开 PLBOA 的 VC-Norm-OFF 对照已偏离 88.0，以对照为准。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:106:- **机制层面已防**：VCA 对齐的是 **batch 级 per-keypoint per-channel 矩（mean/var）**，不是 instance 级特征。身份来自单个 token 在该统计坐标下的**相对位置**，矩对齐只搬动整群分布的中心/尺度，不直接监督「谁是谁」。这与 OA-SD/BT-PKD（instance 级拉近）正交。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:111:  4. **VCA stats**：对齐前/后矩距离应缓降而非骤降到 0（骤降到 0 = 把 student/teacher 统计强行压成一点 = 抹身份）。

experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1504:### 重大发现 1: PAA 是 multi-person occlusion specialist
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1507:- 多人图 (n>=2): PAA vs baseline **+1.69% mAP / +2.02% R1**
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1508:- 单人图 (n=1): PAA vs baseline **+0.47% mAP / -1.61% R1**
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1509:- PAA 在单人图上损害 R1！
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1511:**结论**: PAA 不是通用 feature enhancer，而是专门针对多人遮挡场景的改进。
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1513:### 重大发现 2: ROA 和 PAA 的 mAP 增益完全重叠
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1518:| exp066 PAA | 61.6% | 74.2% |
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1519:| exp079 ROA (无 PAA) | ~61.9% | ~73.2% |
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1520:| exp067 PAA+ROA | ~61.9% | ~73.9% |
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1522:**ROA alone ≈ PAA+ROA**！PAA 的 mAP 贡献被 ROA 完全覆盖。PAA 的独特贡献仅在 R1 上约 +0.7%。

experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1732:### 为什么 EMA prototype 不工作
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1736:1. **EMA prototype 是 lossy compression**：把多个观测平均成一个方向向量，丢失了 instance-specific 的判别细节
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1737:2. **15K 训练集太小**：每个 identity 只有约 15-20 张图，EMA 平均后的 prototype 缺乏足够的统计支撑
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1738:3. **keypoint-level distillation 信号太弱**：只对 ~14.5% 的 keypoints 施加蒸馏，这些 keypoints 本来就是遮挡位置，对最终 pooled feature 的影响有限
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1748:2. **接受当前配置**：PSG+GCN+PAA+ROA 作为训练端最强配置（~62.7% 单 seed），SGCFR 作为测试端独特创新（+2.6%）
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1782:- 来源: OGFR (arXiv 2025) — 76.6% R1, 64.7% mAP on Occluded-Duke (SOTA!)

experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2658:## 2026-03-26: OA-SD 系列实验总结 + Global-Only 新发现
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2660:### OA-SD 核心特性（exp191-194 消融）
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2662:1. **OA-SD + CE = 强正向**: +2.9/+2.6 vs CE base (exp191)
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2663:2. **OA-SD + SupCon (all-token) = 负向**: -0.7/-0.4 (exp188) — 梯度冲突
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2664:3. **EMA decay 不敏感**: 0.99 vs 0.999 最终差异 <1% (exp192)
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2666:5. **OA-SD + 3-view 是 additive**: exp193 = 64.4/76.5 vs exp190 = 64.2/75.6 (+0.2/+0.9)
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2667:6. **OA-SD late-stage boost**: ep40 前拖累 → ep40 crossover → ep60+ 大幅正向
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2669:### 关键新发现：OA-SD Global-Only 解决 SupCon 梯度冲突
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2671:**问题**: OA-SD all-token distillation 与 SupCon 在 per-token features 上产生梯度冲突
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2674:- OA-SD distillation 鼓励 student tokens 逼近 teacher tokens（不管 ID）
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2677:**解决方案**: OA-SD GLOBAL_ONLY — 只在 global (GAP后) feature 上做 distillation
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2678:- Global feature: CE + triplet + OA-SD distill（三者协同）
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2679:- Per-token features: CE + triplet + SupCon（三者协同，无 OA-SD 干扰）
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2681:**验证** (exp195): SupCon + OA-SD global-only ep70=60.2/73.4
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2683:- R1 稳定领先 CE+OA-SD（SupCon 的 R1 优势保持）
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2687:- 全局遮挡不变性 (OA-SD) 和局部判别力 (SupCon) 在不同特征级别独立优化
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2695:| 2 | exp193 | 3-view + OA-SD + CE | 64.4% | 76.5% |
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2698:| 5 | exp194 | OA-SD + CE (w=2.0) | 63.4% | 74.8% |
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2699:| 6 | exp191 | OA-SD + CE | 63.2% | 75.4% |
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2704:3-view + SupCon + OA-SD global-only — 预计 65.0-65.5/77.0-77.5
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2720:- RKD (CVPR 2019): distill pairwise distance/angle structure
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2721:- CRD (ICLR 2020): distillation AS contrastive learning (InfoNCE-based)
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2722:- **直接解决 OA-SD vs SupCon 冲突**: 不 match 个体特征(会冲突) → match 关系结构(不冲突)
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2737:- OA-SD + SupCon: 互斥，即使 global-only 也无法叠加 (exp195/196)
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2743:- Loss: KL(teacher_sim_softmax || student_sim_softmax)
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2748:## 2026-03-30: EMA Distillation 与 SupCon 互斥性确认

experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2760:| exp200 | OA-RD relational + CE | CE | ~-1.0/-3.4 | ❌ OA-RD 不如 OA-SD |
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2764:1. **EMA self-distillation 与 SupCon 本质互斥** — 无论 distill 什么（feature/relation），都不行
experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2765:2. **OA-SD (feature distillation) 在 CE 路线有效**，但 OA-RD (relational) 在 CE 路线不如 OA-SD

experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:2769:4. **OA-RD 是负结果** — relational distillation 的 KL divergence 信号太弱且不稳定

experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:15:  student==teacher → loss=0；全遮挡 teacher → valid_k=0、loss=0、grad finite。这些 load-bearing 正确性主张**真实成立**。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:25:- **新于 OA-SD/BT-PKD 确认**：OA-SD 蒸 pooled global cosine（instance 级），BT-PKD 蒸 per-keypoint 方向 cosine（instance 级）。VCA 对齐的是 **batch 级 per-keypoint per-channel mean/var**，不监督"谁是谁"——机制上确实正交，不是换皮。代码里也确实如此（`_weighted_moments` 在 dim=0/batch 上聚合）。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:26:- 单变量对照设计正确：design.md §对照组明确"严格单变量 = 同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关"，并诚实说明**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（原 exp260b PLBOA=False），88.0 仅作量级参照。这一点处理得对（见下方 High-1 的隐患）。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:40:- teacher detach：`t = teacher_kp.float().detach()`，且 `t_mean.detach()/t_var.detach()` 二次保险，单向对齐。dryrun 实测 teacher.grad is None。✅
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:41:- vis_thr 跳过：teacher 用 `(t_sc>=vis_thr)*t_sc` 加权，valid_k 由 `t_wsum>=min_weight` 门控，全遮挡→valid_k=0→零损失保图(`(student_kp*0).sum()`)。✅
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:48:- dual-forward 接线：student 走 `model(v_img)`（LGPA+GCN 分支，line 599-622）→ `kp_data['gcn_kp_feats']`；teacher 走 `ema_teacher(img_teacher, pose_dict=teacher_pose)`（train mode）→ `teacher_kp_data['gcn_kp_feats']`。parallel_oa_sd 下 `kp_data=all_kpdata[0]`（student view-0），teacher 是 clean 第 4 视图。配对正确。✅
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:49:- 复用现成前向、不新增 backbone pass：teacher 前向是 OA-SD 既有的，VCA 只读它的 kp_data，无额外前向。✅
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:53:- PLBOA 确实把 student 被遮挡 keypoint 的 score/visibility/heatmap 全部清 0（pose_dataset.py:871-874），occluded-vs-clean 非对称信号真实存在，VCA 前提在数据侧成立。✅
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:68:- **High-1 [实验设计 / 对照基线]**：yml 与 exp260b baseline 的差异不止 VC-Norm 一项——本 yml `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`，而原 exp260b 88.0 是 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False` 跑出来的。VC-Norm 需要 PLBOA 提供 occluded-vs-clean 信号，所以开 PLBOA 是必须的，但这意味着 **"88.0"不能直接当对照**。design.md 已经诚实指出这点，但**必须实跑 VC-Norm-OFF + PLBOA-ON 的对照实验**才能算 VC-Norm 净增益，否则结论无效。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:69:  修法：正式训练时务必同时排一条 `POSE_VCNORM=False`（其余完全相同含 PLBOA=True）的对照；results.md 里 VC-Norm 增益只能 vs 这条对照，不能 vs 88.0。**这是实验有效性的硬前提，不是代码 bug。**
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:72:- **Medium-1 [对齐目标的语义]**：VCA 的 teacher target `t_kp` = teacher 路 GCN token **经过 teacher 自己的 VCN 之后**的输出（VCN 在 skeleton_gcn forward 内单点应用，teacher 前向也走这条路）。但探针测的是**raw GCN token**的统计 shift。teacher VCN 起步是恒等(zero-init)，前期 t_kp≈raw，但训练后 teacher VCN（EMA 跟随 student）会改写 t_kp，于是"对齐目标"本身在动。这不是错（EMA self-distill 范式本就如此），但要意识到：**对齐的是 VCN 后的统计，不是探针 raw 统计**。建议日志同时记录 `vca_md/vca_sd` 是否单调下降以确认对齐在收敛；若不收敛，考虑把 VCA 接到 pre-VCN 的 raw GCN token（design §预期失败原因 3 已提到 pre-GCN 备选，可一并考虑 pre-VCN）。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:73:- **Medium-2 [全 batch 遮挡某 keypoint 的 student 矩]**：当某 keypoint 在整个 batch 都被 PLBOA 遮挡时，student `s_w[k]≈0`，`_weighted_moments` 的 `wsum_safe=clamp(eps)` 使 `s_mean[k]` 退化为 `(≈0)/(1e-5)` 的噪声值。该 keypoint 仍可能因 teacher 可见而 `valid_k=True`，于是 student 噪声矩被强行对齐到 teacher → 噪声梯度。lower-body keypoint(脚踝/膝)被 PLBOA 高概率遮挡，batch=64 下全遮挡虽罕见但非零。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:74:  修法（建议，非阻断）：valid_k 同时加 student 侧门控，例如 `valid_k = (t_wsum>=min_weight) & (s_wsum>=min_weight_student)`，跳过 student 自己几乎没样本的 keypoint。当前不会 NaN（有 eps/clamp 保护），只是引入少量噪声梯度，可先跑、观察 vca_vk 是否异常偏低。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:86:代码质量高：插件式、zero-init 恒等、teacher detach、train/test 单点对称、AMP dtype 处理、优化器自动纳管、baseline 复现性（关开关=no-op）全部正确，dryrun 的 load-bearing 正确性主张本地实跑通过。机制确实新于 OA-SD/BT-PKD（batch 级统计矩对齐 vs instance 级特征蒸馏），有探针支撑，是 problem-level 创新而非小调参。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:88:**无 Critical / 无 High 级代码 bug。** 唯一 High 是实验设计前提（必须跑 PLBOA-ON 的 VC-Norm-OFF 对照，不能拿 88.0 当对照）——design.md 已意识到，只需在执行时落实。Medium/Low 均为可观察、非阻断的改进项（建议训练时盯 `vca_md/vca_sd` 单调性、`vca_vk` 数量、`vcn_gain_std` 不塌缩）。
experiments/exp328_vcnorm/claude_review.md:90:**审查通过**（前提：正式训练前 ① 把本地这套文件同步到 lab-3090-d 并在远程补跑一次带 CUDA 的 dryrun；② 务必同排 `POSE_VCNORM=False`+PLBOA 的单变量对照）。代码层面可以进入第二轮 Codex 审查。

experiments/transfer_candidates.json:3:"title": "Robust mixed-degradation person Re-identification via structural consistency distillation",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:6:"transfer_to_occluded": "Treat occluded vs holistic images as the \"degraded vs clean\" domain pair and apply the Fused Gromov-Wasserstein alignment: use the Wasserstein term to pull occluded-sample features toward a training-only holistic reference branch (global centroid correction) while the Gromov-Wasserstein term enforces that the pairwise relational geometry among identities is preserved despite missing body regions. The key transferable trick is preserving intra-identity *relational structure* (GWD on pairwise distance matrices) rather than only matching absolute feature positions — occlusion warps the manifold topology of an ID, so distilling relational consistency from a holistic teacher could regularize occluded embeddings without needing aligned part correspondences. The EWC/CFR idea also transfers: when fine-tuning on occluded data, Fisher-weighted regularization against a holistic-trained checkpoint could prevent forgetting of discriminative cues that survive in visible regions.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:8:"novel_component": "Casting domain alignment as Fused Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport that simultaneously corrects the global distribution shift (Wasserstein term) AND preserves the intra-domain pairwise relational topology of identities (Gromov-Wasserstein term) within one Sinkhorn plan — distilling *relational structure* from a clean teacher branch, not just centroid matching, with the teacher branch dropped entirely at inference."
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:14:"transfer_to_occluded": "Adapt the VCS \"corrupt-a-parsed-region + feature-consistency loss\" trick to occlusion: use human parsing (or an occluder mask) to identify non-target/occluded regions, synthesize occlusion by replacing those pixels with random pixels sampled from a per-batch pool, then add an L2/MSE alignment loss pulling the corrupted-image feature toward the clean-image feature. This is a training-only, self-supervised occlusion-augmentation regularizer that teaches the backbone to produce features invariant to corrupted/missing regions, without needing extra inference modules or pose at test time. The batch-pool pixel-shuffle (rather than zero/black masking) is the transferable detail — it injects realistic distractor texture instead of constant fills, which better mimics real occluders.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:23:"novel_component": "A confidence-gated per-keypoint-to-patch correspondence learned via an affine-extended Mahalanobis + cosine similarity matrix (instead of coarse pose-to-global-feature mapping), combined with a pose loss that explicitly drives down similarity between human-part and non-human features — together separating occlusion semantics from identity semantics at patch granularity, with a texture-distinctiveness channel specifically targeting person-on-person occlusion.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:30:"transfer_to_occluded": "The dissimilarity-driven dual-stage compensation is directly portable to occlusion. Treat occluded body regions as \"missing attributes\" and a holistic reference (a pose prototype, a holistic-image feature, or a clean part-feature memory) as the bridge: use cross-attention to compute a (1 − similarity) \"missing-ness\" mask over body parts/channels, inject only the missing content via channel gating + residual term, then run a refinement stage that subtracts content already present/inconsistent with the reference (weighted by reference-similarity) to avoid filling occluded regions with hallucinated or occluder-derived features. This separates \"fill what is missing\" from \"remove what is corrupted/distractor\" in one module, and the whole bridge+compensation apparatus is training-only so it adds zero inference cost — attractive for occluded ReID feature completion that today often hallucinates or copies occluder content.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:37:"mechanism": "CSSA learns pixel-level part labels without any external pose/parsing model: it separates foreground from background by the heuristic that foreground feature maps have stronger L2-norm response, clusters foreground pixels via k-means across a clip (Np=6 fixed clusters), and uses cluster IDs as pseudo-labels to iteratively train a pixel-wise part classifier producing Np+1 confidence maps (parts plus background/occlusion). A CARE module aggregates the whole clip into a denoised video-level embedding (encoder-decoder with an identity cross-entropy bottleneck) and uses its cross-pixel cosine similarity to each frame pixel as a weighted residual gate that amplifies pixels consistent with the dominant identity and suppresses clutter/occluders. SGFA then builds the global feature pair-wise: each semantic part's contribution to the aggregated global vector is weighted by the product of its query and gallery confidence scores, so a part counts only when reliable in both images.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:43:"title": "Categorical Attention: Fine-grained Language-guided Noise Filtering Network for Occluded Person Re-Identification (FLaN-Net)",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:47:"novel_component": "Per-feature entropy-as-uncertainty dynamic weighting: each fused feature stream's contribution weight is computed from the entropy of that stream's own softmax ID-classification distribution (lower entropy = more reliable = larger weight, via a softmax over Max(E)-E). This is a cheap, label-free, self-calibrating reliability gate that turns the classifier's own confidence into fusion weights and is transferable to any multi-branch ReID model where some branches degrade under occlusion.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:51:"title": "Attribute Guidance With Inherent Pseudo-label For Occluded Person Re-identification (AG-ReID)",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:59:"title": "Heterogeneous Generative Tokens and Distance-Aware Recovery Network for Occluded Person Re-Identification",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:61:"mechanism": "A dual-stream ViT (holistic ViT-B/16 global stream + Swin-based part stream). The part stream: (1) SPG builds variable-scale \"semantic patches\" by windowed spatial pooling into cluster centers plus local multi-head attention, then refines them by alternating CLS-merge / patch-key-value transformer layers to inject global context; (2) AHSTG scores each semantic patch with a Discrimination Indicator Score (self-attention of CLS to patch) and Relevance Indicator Score (cosine affinity to identity), sums and softmax-normalizes them, selects the top-K as cluster centers, and generates K heterogeneous tokens of differing scale/shape via score-biased attention — tokens whose aggregated patches all have low scores are labeled as occlusion; (3) DFR projects the K selected token indices into a 2D grid, computes planar Euclidean distance between spatially adjacent heterogeneous tokens, and where the gap is large (inferred occlusion) inserts a recovery token, then recovers it by a softmax-over-negative-distance weighted aggregation of neighbor tokens so spatially closer neighbors contribute more. Trained with weighted-by-score ID loss + triplet on both streams; final descriptor concatenates global, part, and recovery features. Reports 71.8/62.3 on Occluded-Duke.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:62:"transfer_to_occluded": "Distance-aware neighbor weighting for occluded-region recovery: rather than completing a missing/occluded region by uniform or pure attention-based aggregation (as in MAE-style or FCFormer completion), assign each visible neighbor token a weight = softmax(-Euclidean distance in the spatial token grid), so spatially nearer tokens dominate the reconstruction. Combine with the gap-detection trick — project surviving discriminative tokens into 2D, measure inter-token distance, and where a large spatial gap appears, infer an occlusion and insert a learnable recovery token to be filled. This is a cheap, prior-driven (spatial-locality) alternative/complement to learned attention completion and could be dropped into any token-level feature-completion module in an occluded ReID pipeline.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:63:"novel_component": "The distance-aware recovery weighting: completing an occluded token by aggregating neighbors with weights = softmax(-planar Euclidean distance) in the spatial token grid, encoding the prior that spatially closer features carry more relevant information than a uniform/attention average — plus detecting occlusion as a large spatial gap between surviving discriminative tokens and inserting a recovery token there.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:70:"transfer_to_occluded": "CPDM's \"inverse-PCB\" consecutive patch dropout is directly relevant to occluded ReID: during training, systematically zero out each horizontal body stripe one at a time and supervise an ID/triplet loss on each resulting incomplete feature map, forcing the network to extract discriminative identity cues from every region rather than collapsing onto a single dominant (often occlusion-vulnerable) region. This is a structured, region-complete simulation of occlusion that, unlike random erasing/DropBlock, guarantees each region is dropped exactly once per sample and reuses the same drop pattern across the feature stack — a cheap training-time regularizer that adds zero test-time cost (heads discarded at inference) and should improve robustness when query/gallery has missing body parts.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:77:"mechanism": "Models clothing as a confounder C in a structural causal model X←C→Y and replaces likelihood training P(Y|X) with causal-intervention training P(Y|do(X))=Σ_c P(Y|X,c)·P(c) via backdoor adjustment, cutting the \"clothing shortcut\" backdoor path. Three modules implement it: a Confounder Dictionary storing each clothing item as a multivariate Gaussian N(μ,σ²) with prior P(c) (EMA-updated, clothing features isolated by reverse-attention masking of the identity map), an Intervention Module that samples K diverse per-clothing features, condition-injects them into the image feature and uses the NWGM trick (Eq.12) to pull the classifier out of the Σ_c sum so the whole intervention is one classification, and a Disentangle Regularization (orthogonal + KL + feature-separation losses) keeping clothing reps identity-free. Backbone-agnostic (ResNet-50 / ViT); causal/clothing streams used only in training, inference uses the identity stream alone.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:80:"novel_component": "The NWGM-approximated backdoor adjustment implemented as a feature-level Confounder Dictionary: each nuisance factor is stored as an EMA-updated Gaussian N(μ,σ²) with a prior, K samples are drawn and condition-injected into the identity feature, and the classifier is moved outside the Σ_c sum (NWGM) so marginalizing over the confounder costs one forward pass — turning the abstract \"intervene over all confounder values\" into a cheap, train-only operation that disappears at inference."
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:86:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply the text-level orthogonal-projection disentanglement to occlusion: learn a dual prompt for the OCCLUDER/distractor (e.g. \"a photo of the [X]...[X] occluder\") alongside the ID prompt, then orthogonalize the occluder text feature out of the ID text feature (F_ort = F_id - proj of F_occ onto F_id) and use the purged ID text feature to guide the visual encoder via the non-local SIM. Because the non-local operation aggregates from spatially distant but semantically relevant regions, it is well suited to occluded ReID where visible body parts are scattered far from the occluded/corrupted region — letting the model pull ID evidence from non-adjacent visible patches rather than local self-attention that gets dominated by the occluder. The orthogonalization gives a clean way to subtract a known nuisance direction (occluder appearance) without an auxiliary parser.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:91:"title": "Adaptive Occlusion-Aware Network for Occluded Person Re-Identification",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:93:"mechanism": "AOANet uses a Swin-S backbone plus two modules. The Adaptive Position Extractor (APE) defines 4 learnable \"part catchers\" (query vectors) that cross-attend to high-level features f4, then self-attend + FFN, and are fused with shallow FPN features (f1,f2) via MLP+sigmoid to produce 4 soft spatial part-region maps P=[P1..P4] (head, upper body, thigh, lower leg); these maps are supervised by PifPaf pose labels during training only, so no pose model is needed at inference. Local features come from Weighted Average Pooling GAP(interp(f4)⊙P_i). At inference the Occlusion Awareness Module (OAM) computes a per-part occlusion weight as the normalized spatial area of each region map, takes the element-wise minimum of the two images' per-part weights, and forms the final similarity as a weighted sum of the 5 per-part Euclidean distances (global feature weight fixed to 1). Trained with id+triplet on global features, average triplet on parts, and a cross-entropy region loss; reaches 70.6 mAP / 81.2 R1 on Occluded-Duke.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:94:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly transferable ideas. (1) The OAM pairwise matching rule: derive a per-part visibility/occlusion weight (here just the spatial area of the learned region mask), then for a query-gallery pair take the MIN of the two weights per part before weighting that part's distance — so a part contributes only when it is visible in BOTH images, and the global feature is always kept at weight 1 as a fallback. This is a simple, learning-free, symmetric \"common-visible support\" rule that can wrap any part-based occluded ReID model and is directly applicable to an occluded-ReID setup that already has part/keypoint visibility scores. (2) Pose-distillation: supervise spatial part-region extractors with pose labels at TRAIN time but drop the pose model at TEST time, so pose-estimation noise on heavily-occluded test images never propagates into the features — relevant because pose error on occluded images is a known failure mode.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:96:"novel_component": "The \"min-of-pairwise occlusion weights\" matching rule: instead of weighting each part by a single image's visibility, weight it by the minimum of the query's and gallery's part-visibility, so a body part only influences the score when it is co-visible in both images — a symmetric pair-comparability gate that requires no extra training and keeps the always-available global feature at fixed weight 1."
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:99:"title": "Occluded person Re-Identification with noise injection",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:101:"mechanism": "Treats large-scale vehicle images (auto-collectable via license-plate recognition, framed as \"positive-incentive noise\") as a free training resource for occluded person ReID. Two strategies: ENI alternates the training set between person-only and vehicle-only/mixed epochs every S epochs as a regularizer; INI synthesizes realistic vehicle-occluded persons by copy-pasting a randomly-sized cropped vehicle segment into the lower-body region of person images (height-ratio r controls occlusion placement). A dual-branch CNN fuses global (avg+max pool) and local (spatial-partition + max pool) features, supervised by ID cross-entropy on both branches plus triplet loss on the global feature; no parsing nets or manual masks needed.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:103:"novel_component": "Reframing an \"unwanted noise\" domain (vehicle images) as positive-incentive noise (π-noise) that, via information-theoretic argument, reduces the recognition task's conditional entropy — and operationalizing it as a cheap, annotation-free occluder source for realistic copy-paste occlusion augmentation rather than treating it as data to discard.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:109:"mechanism": "HFLAT is a ViT-based occluded ReID model with three modules over the patch token sequence. (1) Feature Hierarchical Fusion Module (FHFM): computes each patch's relative importance to the [CLS] token as I_i = M_cls,i * ||z_i|| / sum, sorts patches by importance, splits them into 4 equal-size sub-sequences (most->least important), and cumulatively fuses them (F1=top, F2=F1+med, F3=F2+mid, F4=F3+low) so high-importance patches contribute to all fused levels — amplifying key-region identity cues. (2) Feature Separation Module (FSM): an MLP + 3x3 conv + sigmoid produces a patch-level saliency map a, splitting features into foreground (F*a) and background (F*(1-a)) with a foreground-background contrastive loss, suppressing background/occlusion without external pose/parsing. (3) Local Feature Extraction Module (LFEM): appends 4 learnable local tokens (top-to-bottom body regions) and uses local-aware masked multi-head attention where a binary Mask restricts attention so patches and their local token only attend within the same region, extracting 4 fine-grained part features. Final descriptor concatenates CLS, fused, foreground and 4 local features. Reports 64.7/79.6 (mAP/R1) on Occluded-DukeMTMC, 84.9/89.8 on Occluded-ReID.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:112:"novel_component": "Importance-ranked CUMULATIVE hierarchical fusion (FHFM): instead of pooling all tokens equally or hard-masking occluded ones, sort patch tokens by relative importance to CLS (attention*norm), partition into ordered tiers, and fuse cumulatively (F_k = F_{k-1} + tier_k) so the most-confident/visible patches are reinforced across all fusion levels while uncertain/occluded patches enter only the last level. This is a soft, fully label-free way to weight tokens by reliability — transferable as an uncertainty-aware token aggregation that avoids both equal pooling and brittle hard occlusion masks."
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:119:"transfer_to_occluded": "Repurpose the mask-guided, pose-conditioned diffusion inpainting from \"swap the clothing region\" to \"fill the occluded region\": use a body-segmentation/visibility mask to mark missing or occluder-corrupted body parts, then inpaint them with OpenPose-keypoint-conditioned Stable Diffusion to synthesize plausible body content, generating occlusion-augmented training pairs (or recovered query images). Critically, transfer their two-stage quality gate — admit a recovered region only if its ReID-feature similarity to the clean identity is high and its FID is low — so hallucinated content is filtered before it pollutes training, addressing the chronic risk that completion/inpainting injects identity-inconsistent features in occluded ReID.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:133:"mechanism": "A dual-stream framework (appearance stream Ea + shape stream Es) for VI-ReID built on AGW. Body shape is parsed by a pre-trained SCHP human-parsing model; infrared shapes are unreliable because skin/background look similar in IR, so the parser misses limbs. Three components fix and exploit this: (1) Infrared Shape Restoration (ISR) — a spatial cross-attention at an intermediate backbone block where the query is built by summing the IR shape feature map and the IR appearance feature map, and key/value come from IR appearance features, so missing shape regions are searched for and restored from appearance; clean VIS shape features (no restoration) are mixed into the same loss batch to implicitly supervise the restoration. (2) Shape Feature Propagation (SFP) — a replicated 4th block of the appearance encoder (Es-tilde) is distilled from the shape stream at both instance level (L2) and prototype level (CE to class prototypes), so at inference the heavy shape stream and parser are dropped. (3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:134:"transfer_to_occluded": "Reframe occlusion as a \"corrupted-region restoration at the feature level\" problem and reuse ISR: for an occluded ID, treat the occluded/missing body regions like the missing IR limbs. Build a query by summing a body-structure feature map (e.g., pose/parsing heatmap features — exactly this repo's PSG pose branch) with the appearance feature map, and run spatial cross-attention with key/value from the appearance features, so the network searches the unoccluded regions to restore plausible features for the missing region — instead of zeroing/masking occluded parts. Critically, the supervision trick transfers cleanly: mix clean (holistic, non-occluded) samples' shape/part features into the same loss batch as the restored occluded features under a shared classifier + WRT triplet, so the holistic samples implicitly supervise restoration WITHOUT needing per-pixel ground truth for the occluded region. This is a label-free way to train feature-level completion, which prior occluded-ReID completion attempts in this repo found hard to supervise.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:147:"title": "Latent Diffusion-Guided Feature Inpainting for Occluded Person Re-Identification With Hybrid Re-Ranking",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:150:"transfer_to_occluded": "This paper IS occluded ReID, so the whole pipeline is on-domain, but the single most transferable trick is treating occlusion as an explicitly invertible map T in FEATURE space and learning T^-1 with paired clean/occluded-feature supervision — instead of masking/suppressing occluded regions, you generatively reconstruct the clean identity embedding before it reaches the ReID head. Concretely transferable pieces: (1) train a feature-space de-occluder on synthetic occlusion pairs (silhouette-guided background patching + Fourier-domain adaptation to bridge synth-to-real) where the FROZEN ViT clean feature is the ground truth, so no occlusion masks are needed at test time; (2) keep both reconstructed and raw occluded features and fuse them with cross-attention (Q=clean, K/V=occluded) rather than discarding the occluded one — the reconstruction acts as a query that re-attends the raw features toward visible identity regions, which is robust when reconstruction is imperfect; (3) the reconstruction-loss-as-classifier-guidance idea turns an unconditional generative module into an identity-preserving deterministic operator, directly useful for any completion-based occluded-ReID module to avoid hallucinating wrong identities.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:151:"novel_component": "Formulating occlusion as a deterministic, invertible transform T in deep-feature space and learning its inverse T^-1 via a latent diffusion model supervised by paired clean ViT features — i.e. feature-space inpainting where a reconstruction loss plays the role of classifier guidance, yielding a deterministic identity-preserving de-occluder rather than a stochastic sampler, and crucially requiring no masks/pose/parsing at inference.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:155:"title": "Pose-Skeleton Guided Cross-Attention Representation Fusion for Occluded Pedestrian Re-Identification",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:163:"title": "Occlusion-aware Cross-modality Completion Network for Occluded Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:165:"mechanism": "OCCNet treats occlusion as a completion problem rather than discarding occluded regions. A shared ResNet50 extracts modality-specific token maps, then a Graph-guided Feature Completion Transformer (GFCT) builds a dynamic semantic adjacency matrix from latent token similarities and uses it as an Adaptive Graph-guided Attention bias to restrict self-attention to semantically related token pairs, completing occluded tokens by aggregating from clean contextual tokens across the whole image. A Semantic-aware Region Completion Module (SRCM) clusters tokens into semantic regions (top-K similarity prototypes), refines them with multi-order graph convolutions (Graph Context Perception), and uses Cross-modality Soft Querying to pull complementary cues from the other modality's region memory bank; a Multi-Distribution Consistency Alignment (MCA) loss aligns token-level and region-level completions to their averaged pseudo-holistic reference via symmetric KL divergence.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:174:"novel_component": "A label-free, near-zero-cost occlusion/visibility detector: sort the cosine similarities between the global feature G and each patch embedding in descending order, take their first-order differences, and pick the index of the maximum difference as the split point between body patches (high similarity to global identity) and background/occlusion patches (low similarity). This treats body vs occlusion as separable classes in feature space and detects the transition without pose estimation or human parsing.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:175:"transfer_to_occluded": "The first-order-difference split point on sorted G-to-patch cosine similarities is a cheap, supervision-free occlusion detector that could be dropped into an occluded-ReID pipeline to estimate which patches/parts are occluded, then drive part-visibility gating (mask occluded part tokens before matching) and a per-part visibility score for MaxSim-style partial matching — all without an external pose/parsing model. Complementary: the Push Loss that contrastively separates a learned background/occlusion feature from the foreground feature could regularize an occluder-aware feature space.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:181:"mechanism": "For video clothes-changing ReID, instead of using sparse 3D skeletons or low-dimensional SMPL parameters for gait, the method distills dense 3D mesh-surface knowledge into the 2D image domain. It pre-trains per-vertex embeddings on the canonical SMPL mesh via a GCN, supervised so that embedding L2 distances match mesh geodesic distances and embedding angles match surface tangent angles; a lightweight U-Net extractor is then trained to assign every foreground pixel an embedding equal to its underlying 3D vertex's embedding, forming a per-frame \"structured distilled 3D gait field\" that is spatially/temporally aligned with the video. Local similarity learning plus a dual-granularity token cross-attention module (MRIE) then fuse this gait field with clothing-desensitized appearance features.",
experiments/transfer_candidates.json:182:"transfer_to_occluded": "Adopt the dense pixel-to-3D-vertex correspondence embedding as an occlusion-aware matching substrate: train a per-pixel head that maps each foreground pixel to a canonical SMPL-vertex embedding (supervised by geodesic/tangent-consistent vertex codes). Then (a) occluded/missing body regions are explicitly detected as 3D vertices with no supporting pixel, yielding a per-vertex visibility/support map for free, and (b) two images are matched only over their shared visible 3D vertices (\"common visible support\"), making the comparison occlusion-robust without relying on holistic features. The cross-frame \"same-vertex => consistent embedding\" constraint also provides a structural prior to inpaint or down-weight corrupted regions.",

experiments/exp130/claude_review.md:10:but no equivalent guard for `'residual_kl'`. Without a support teacher, `dist_t == dist_base`, making all teacher residual logits exactly zero → uniform teacher distribution → KL loss pushes student to uniform → actively harmful.
experiments/exp130/claude_review.md:25:`base_dist` already comes from `_aggregate_teacher_dist(kp_feats)` which calls `.detach()`. Harmless, cosmetic only.
experiments/exp130/claude_review.md:45:where `p_t = softmax(-(dist_t - dist_base)/tau)` and `p_s = softmax(-(dist_s - dist_base)/tau)`. Since softmax is a **nonlinear** function of the logits, the base vector does NOT cancel — it shifts relative logit magnitudes and therefore changes the resulting probability distribution. The student receives a genuinely different supervisory signal than in full mode.

experiments/exp254/claude_review.md:170:建议：训练开始后，在 log 中确认无 `[PAA]` 打印，作为 PAA 确实禁用的二次验证。
experiments/exp254/claude_review.md:178:| PAA 禁用逻辑 (init L73-93 + forward L395-397) | 通过 |
experiments/exp254/claude_review.md:193:审查通过。exp254 是一个设计清晰的消融实验，填补 PSG 阶段表中 "2-stage 无 PAA" 的空格。代码逐行验证确认：(1) `[-2,-1]` 正确解析为 Stage 2+3；(2) PAA 在 `POSE_ADDITIVE_ADAPTER=False` 时从 init 到 forward 完全禁用，不存在遗漏调用；(3) Stage 2 downsample 在 PSG 注入之后正确执行；(4) 单变量隔离满足两个方向的对照需求。无 VRAM 风险，无 train/test 不对称，无 AMP 或优化器问题。

experiments/exp112/design.md:5:`exp110` 证明了 `support-complete distillation` 的训练端最小原型可以转正，但增益偏弱。当前最自然的解释之一是 prototype teacher 仍然不够干净：`POSE_SCKD_UPDATE_THR=0.5` 允许中等可见度 keypoint 进入 bank，这会把遮挡噪声、姿态提取误差和局部不稳定特征一并写入 teacher。
experiments/exp112/design.md:7:本地 `exp111` 正在验证“support 数量门槛”是否重要；为了并行判断 teacher reliability 的另一半来源，本实验专门测试 **support 纯度**。
experiments/exp112/design.md:11:如果只允许更高可见度的 keypoint 更新 prototype bank，teacher 会更干净，进而让 `SCKD` 的训练信号更可靠。

experiments/exp349_small_full_clip/claude_review.md:48:### 5. OA-SD EMA teacher 与 CLIP prompt —— 安全（含一处可接受的内存代价） ✓ / Low
experiments/exp349_small_full_clip/claude_review.md:50:- EMA teacher = `copy.deepcopy(base_model)`（processor line 478），**深拷贝整个 student，含 clip_id_prompt（冻结 ViT-L 文本编码器 + 可学习 cls_ctx）与 LGPA 的 clip_text_features buffer**。
experiments/exp349_small_full_clip/claude_review.md:51:- teacher forward（line 821）在 `torch.no_grad()` 下会重算 clip_id_loss，但 line 832-833 **只取 teacher_feat，clip_id_loss 被丢弃**，不进图、不回传。✓
experiments/exp349_small_full_clip/claude_review.md:52:- EMA 更新（line 1321-1322）遍历 `ema_teacher.parameters()` 包含冻结 CLIP 参数：student 侧这些 CLIP 参数 `requires_grad=False` 且训练全程不变，EMA blend `t = decay*t + (1-decay)*s` 在 t==s 时为恒等 → **冻结 CLIP 在 teacher 中保持与 student 一致**，无副作用。cls_ctx（可学习）会被正常 EMA 跟踪，符合自蒸馏语义。✓
experiments/exp349_small_full_clip/claude_review.md:53:- buffer EMA（line 1324-1327）只更新 float32 且 shape 匹配的 buffer；LGPA 的 `clip_text_features`（float32 buffer）会被 EMA blend，但 student 侧它是常量 buffer（注册后不变）→ teacher 侧同样恒等保持。✓ 无破坏。
experiments/exp349_small_full_clip/claude_review.md:54:- **Low（内存）**：deepcopy 使 ViT-L 文本编码器在显存中存在两份（student + teacher）。ViT-L-14 文本塔参数量有限（远小于视觉塔），且 teacher 在 no_grad 下 forward、不存激活梯度，BS=64 下风险低。见第 8 点显存评估。
experiments/exp349_small_full_clip/claude_review.md:56:### 6. PLBOA（POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC）正交性 —— 确认 ✓
experiments/exp349_small_full_clip/claude_review.md:58:PLBOA 是数据增强（下半身遮挡），作用在输入图像/student view 上，OA-SD 用 clean（pre-PLBOA）图像与 pose 喂 teacher（line 819-824 `teacher_pose = pose_dict.get('teacher_pose', pose_dict)`，line 557 `img_teacher = img[3]` 为 clean view）。CLIP prompt 对齐的是 student 的 global_feat（带 PLBOA 遮挡）到 per-ID 文本原型 —— 这反而是「让被遮挡图也对齐纯 ID 语义」，与 PLBOA 目标方向一致、不冲突。✓ 纯增强，与 CLIP loss 计算路径无耦合。
experiments/exp349_small_full_clip/claude_review.md:80:- 静态权重：Swin-Small 全系统 + 冻结 ViT-L-14 文本塔（student）+ EMA teacher 深拷贝（再一份 ViT-L 文本塔）。ViT-L **文本** 塔参数量约 ~120M 级，两份约几百 MB，相对 24G 显存占比小。
experiments/exp349_small_full_clip/claude_review.md:81:- 激活峰值：parallel_oa_sd 每 step 跑 **3 个 student forward（带梯度）+ 1 个 teacher forward（no_grad）**，已是 exp255 既有开销；CLIP-ID 仅多一个 text transformer forward（77 token，B 条 prompt，no 视觉塔）→ 增量小。
experiments/exp349_small_full_clip/claude_review.md:83:- 另：clip_id_prompt 的 cls_ctx 是 `num_classes × 4 × ctx_dim`（Occluded-Duke 702 × 4 × 768 ≈ 2.2M 个 float），可忽略。
experiments/exp349_small_full_clip/claude_review.md:98:逐行核对了 clip_id_loss 在 LGPA+GCN dual 分支的注入与透传（model line 733/747-749 → processor line 1297）、parallel_aug 4-view 下的单次计数（view0 only + loss_fn 不读 clip_id）、Swin-Small in_planes=768 与 clip_id_proj 维度匹配、OA-SD EMA 深拷贝对冻结 CLIP 的恒等性、两次 CLIP 加载（ViT-B-32 buffer vs ViT-L-14 子模块）无 key 冲突、PLBOA 正交、单变量隔离（仅 POSE_CLIP_ID_PROMPT）。未发现 Critical/High 阻断项。唯一硬性提醒：**启动训练命令必须 `TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH 64` override**（流程铁律，防 eval OOM）。其余为 Low 级继承自 exp341 的已验证项。

experiments/exp355r_pgpd_random/design.md:5:核心赌注: **CLIP-ReID 的 ID-prompt simplex 里藏着"类间邻域几何"(这张图离哪些别的 ID 近)——这是 ID-CE/triplet 给不了、LGPA 部位分支也表达不了的软信息。** 用 pose 选一个"更完整的同 ID teacher", 把它在 prompt simplex 上的暗分布(对其他 ID 的相似度)蒸馏给遮挡 student → 遮挡 student 继承完整视图的干净 ID 边界。
experiments/exp355r_pgpd_random/design.md:8:- **不被吸收**: 不在 CLIP i2t/t2i 对齐里加 pose 通路。pose 只做 (a) 选 teacher (b) 构造遮挡 (c) GRL 去姿态。蒸馏目标是 prompt simplex 上的软分布(已有量), 无新带参 ID 通路。
experiments/exp355r_pgpd_random/design.md:14:1. **pose 完整度**: `comp_i = target_heatmaps[i].amax(dim=(1,2)).sum()`(每图**目标人**可见关键点强度和, detach)。**用 target_heatmaps 非 scene(max-merge 多人)**——否则多人遮挡图里干扰者会虚高完整度误导 teacher 选择(Codex Medium)。target 不可用时 fallback scene。
experiments/exp355r_pgpd_random/design.md:15:2. **batch 内 teacher 选择**: 对每个 student i, 在**同 ID** 且 `comp_j > comp_i` 中选 comp 最大的 j 当 teacher。无更完整同 ID → 该图无蒸馏(w=0)。
experiments/exp355r_pgpd_random/design.md:17:4. **暗知识 KL(对硬负)**: 对 student i / teacher j, 屏蔽各自真 ID 那列(只留 P-1 硬负), `L_dark_i = KL(log_softmax(logits_i_masked) ‖ softmax(stopgrad(logits_j_masked)))`。teacher 分布 stop-grad(teacher 只当目标不被拉)。
experiments/exp355r_pgpd_random/design.md:27:失败可能: batch 内同 ID 完整度差异小(teacher≈student, w≈0 蒸馏空转); P=16 暗分布太小(只 15 硬负); 软关系对 occluded-duke 不 load-bearing。
experiments/exp355r_pgpd_random/design.md:31:- **★必做控制 exp355r: random-erase teacher 配对**(teacher 随机选同 ID, 不按 pose 完整度)→ 隔离"pose 选 teacher"的价值。若 exp355 ≈ exp355r, 则 pose 无贡献(只是 KD 正则)。
experiments/exp355r_pgpd_random/design.md:36:- `model/pose_backbone_model.py`: clip_id_loss 块后加 PGPD 块(teacher 选择 + dark KL)。需 scene_heatmaps(已有)、label、global。
experiments/exp355r_pgpd_random/design.md:41:- teacher 选择无同 ID 更完整图时 w=0 安全(不 NaN)。
experiments/exp355r_pgpd_random/design.md:42:- KL 方向对(student 学 teacher, teacher stop-grad)。
experiments/exp355r_pgpd_random/design.md:43:- 屏蔽真 ID 列正确(student/teacher 各自真 ID)。
experiments/exp355r_pgpd_random/design.md:49:- **首版只做核心暗知识蒸馏**(pose 选 teacher + dark KL)。GRL pose-adversarial **延后**(若核心有正信号再加 exp355-grl ablation), 故未加 POSE_PGPD_GRL_W flag。

experiments/exp192/claude_review.md:20:- 0.999: teacher 更新很慢（需要 ~1000 步才能 50% 更新）
experiments/exp192/claude_review.md:21:- 0.99: teacher 更新更快（~100 步 50% 更新）
experiments/exp192/claude_review.md:22:- 更快更新 = teacher 更紧跟 student → distillation target 更 fresh
experiments/exp192/claude_review.md:23:- 风险：太快可能导致 teacher 和 student 太相似，distillation 信号太弱

experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:48:### 5. OA-SD EMA teacher 与 CLIP prompt —— 安全（含一处可接受的内存代价） ✓ / Low
experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:50:- EMA teacher = `copy.deepcopy(base_model)`（processor line 478），**深拷贝整个 student，含 clip_id_prompt（冻结 ViT-L 文本编码器 + 可学习 cls_ctx）与 LGPA 的 clip_text_features buffer**。
experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:51:- teacher forward（line 821）在 `torch.no_grad()` 下会重算 clip_id_loss，但 line 832-833 **只取 teacher_feat，clip_id_loss 被丢弃**，不进图、不回传。✓
experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:52:- EMA 更新（line 1321-1322）遍历 `ema_teacher.parameters()` 包含冻结 CLIP 参数：student 侧这些 CLIP 参数 `requires_grad=False` 且训练全程不变，EMA blend `t = decay*t + (1-decay)*s` 在 t==s 时为恒等 → **冻结 CLIP 在 teacher 中保持与 student 一致**，无副作用。cls_ctx（可学习）会被正常 EMA 跟踪，符合自蒸馏语义。✓
experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:53:- buffer EMA（line 1324-1327）只更新 float32 且 shape 匹配的 buffer；LGPA 的 `clip_text_features`（float32 buffer）会被 EMA blend，但 student 侧它是常量 buffer（注册后不变）→ teacher 侧同样恒等保持。✓ 无破坏。
experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:54:- **Low（内存）**：deepcopy 使 ViT-L 文本编码器在显存中存在两份（student + teacher）。ViT-L-14 文本塔参数量有限（远小于视觉塔），且 teacher 在 no_grad 下 forward、不存激活梯度，BS=64 下风险低。见第 8 点显存评估。
experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:56:### 6. PLBOA（POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC）正交性 —— 确认 ✓
experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:58:PLBOA 是数据增强（下半身遮挡），作用在输入图像/student view 上，OA-SD 用 clean（pre-PLBOA）图像与 pose 喂 teacher（line 819-824 `teacher_pose = pose_dict.get('teacher_pose', pose_dict)`，line 557 `img_teacher = img[3]` 为 clean view）。CLIP prompt 对齐的是 student 的 global_feat（带 PLBOA 遮挡）到 per-ID 文本原型 —— 这反而是「让被遮挡图也对齐纯 ID 语义」，与 PLBOA 目标方向一致、不冲突。✓ 纯增强，与 CLIP loss 计算路径无耦合。
experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:80:- 静态权重：Swin-Small 全系统 + 冻结 ViT-L-14 文本塔（student）+ EMA teacher 深拷贝（再一份 ViT-L 文本塔）。ViT-L **文本** 塔参数量约 ~120M 级，两份约几百 MB，相对 24G 显存占比小。
experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:81:- 激活峰值：parallel_oa_sd 每 step 跑 **3 个 student forward（带梯度）+ 1 个 teacher forward（no_grad）**，已是 exp255 既有开销；CLIP-ID 仅多一个 text transformer forward（77 token，B 条 prompt，no 视觉塔）→ 增量小。
experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:83:- 另：clip_id_prompt 的 cls_ctx 是 `num_classes × 4 × ctx_dim`（Occluded-Duke 702 × 4 × 768 ≈ 2.2M 个 float），可忽略。
experiments/exp349b_small_undetach_clip/claude_review.md:98:逐行核对了 clip_id_loss 在 LGPA+GCN dual 分支的注入与透传（model line 733/747-749 → processor line 1297）、parallel_aug 4-view 下的单次计数（view0 only + loss_fn 不读 clip_id）、Swin-Small in_planes=768 与 clip_id_proj 维度匹配、OA-SD EMA 深拷贝对冻结 CLIP 的恒等性、两次 CLIP 加载（ViT-B-32 buffer vs ViT-L-14 子模块）无 key 冲突、PLBOA 正交、单变量隔离（仅 POSE_CLIP_ID_PROMPT）。未发现 Critical/High 阻断项。唯一硬性提醒：**启动训练命令必须 `TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH 64` override**（流程铁律，防 eval OOM）。其余为 Low 级继承自 exp341 的已验证项。

experiments/exp068/review.md:1:# exp068 RR-PAA 审查报告
experiments/exp068/review.md:13:| 1 | HIGH | pose_additive_adapter.py | RR-PAA 的“routing mask”并没有形成设计里所说的可见/遮挡分离。基于真实 heatmap 抽样统计，Stage 3 上 `body_conf` 平均仅约 `0.52`，`occlusion_mask = 1 - body_conf` 基本落在 `0.34~0.50`，更像对 adapter 做近乎均匀的缩放，而不是“只在低置信度区域激活” | 未修复 |
experiments/exp068/review.md:14:| 2 | MEDIUM | design.md | 设计写的是 suppress-and-complete 式 routed injection，但当前实现只能支持“软衰减版 PAA” | 未修复 |

experiments/exp068/review.md:26:`exp068` 当前没有真正实现“Reliability-Routed”。它测试到的是一个被全局软缩放后的 PAA，而不是面向遮挡区域的 selective completion。

experiments/exp355_pgpd/codex_review.md:19:**Re-confirm**: PGPD 激活在 NOPARAM_POOL 外、PROMPT 内(exp355 prompt+PGPD 都开); POSE_PGPD False 复现 exp341; _pgpd_loss math(student行/teacher列轴、严格更完整、真ID硬负屏蔽、teacher detached、KD 方向、NaN/全零权重处理)全对; train/test 对称(PGPD 仅 self.training, eval 不碰); git diff --check 无空白错误。
